tools.name: inhouse_calculator_guide

returns.description: Calculator index (GOD vs Shopify calculators), workflow guidance (3-step mandatory process), natural language handling (text to parameters), historical patterns (common values), error prevention (4 common mistakes), follow-up tool chain (calculator_guide → get_requirements → calculate_quote)

tools.name: inhouse_query_guide
tools.description: TIER 2B - Query System Guide (Schema v2.0 Dec 2025). Explains pre-built queries (50+ optimized queries across 6 categories) vs custom SQL. CRITICAL: Check pre-built queries FIRST - they are optimized and tested. For custom SQL: MUST call inhouse_database_guide() to get FRED Schema v2.0 BEFORE writing SQL (prevents 'Invalid column name' errors on non-existent columns: Orders.Status/TotalCost, JobTickets.DateCreated/PrintType, PaperSize.Width/Height, BindType.[Desc]). Schema v2.0 validated against production database (FredDEV) with all corrections documented. Two workflows: (1) Pre-built: query_guide → get_query_library_catalog → execute, (2) Custom: query_guide → database_guide v2.0 (MANDATORY) → execute_sql with validated schema.

returns.description: Query categories (6 categories with query counts and examples), workflow guidance (pre-built vs custom SQL with Schema v2.0 requirement), error prevention (4 common mistakes with v2.0 corrections), follow-up tool chains (two options with ASCII diagrams), schema reference (docs/platforms/inhouse_print_database_schema_v2.md)

tools.name: inhouse_database_guide
tools.description: TIER 2D - Database Schema Guide v2.0 (Dec 2025). ALWAYS call this BEFORE inhouse_execute_sql when writing custom SQL. Provides FRED database schema with validated corrections: Orders.Status (DOESN'T EXIST - use Orders.Invoiced bit field), Orders.TotalCost (DOESN'T EXIST - calculate SUM(JobTickets.Cost)), JobTickets.DateCreated (DOESN'T EXIST - use Orders.OrderDate with JOIN), JobTickets.PrintType (DOESN'T EXIST - check TicketNotes), PaperSize.Width/Height (DON'T EXIST - only SizeID and [Desc]), BindType.[Desc] (DOESN'T EXIST - use BindTypeDesc), ColourStatus (is DEADLINE URGENCY 1-7, NOT print color). Returns complete schema for Orders (16 cols), JobTickets (70 cols), all reference tables, JOIN patterns, SQL templates, common mistakes with fixes, best practices. MANDATORY before custom SQL - prevents 'Invalid column name' errors.

returns.description: FRED Schema v2.0 with: (1) Critical warnings (4 non-existent columns), (2) Complete table schemas (Orders 16 cols, JobTickets 70 cols, 13 reference tables), (3) Column details with types and constraints, (4) SQL patterns (5 essential query templates), (5) Common mistakes (5 categories with before/after fixes), (6) Best practices (10 rules), (7) Quick reference cheat sheet, (8) Validation test query. Reference: docs/platforms/inhouse_print_database_schema_v2.md

tools.name: inhouse_execute_sql
tools.description: Execute SQL query against InHousePrintDB (FredDEV @ 3.25.76.138\INHPSQLSERVER) with validated FRED Schema v2.0 corrections. CRITICAL: ALWAYS call inhouse_database_guide() FIRST to get schema - prevents 'Invalid column name' errors. Schema v2.0 validates: Orders.Status (doesn't exist → use Invoiced bit), Orders.TotalCost (doesn't exist → calculate SUM(JobTickets.Cost)), JobTickets.DateCreated (doesn't exist → use Orders.OrderDate with JOIN), JobTickets.PrintType (doesn't exist → check TicketNotes text), PaperSize.Width/Height (don't exist → only SizeID and [Desc]), BindType.[Desc] (doesn't exist → use BindTypeDesc), ColourStatus (is deadline urgency 1-7 NOT print color), [Desc] keyword (requires square brackets on PaperSize/JobType/PaperType/JobStage/GSM). MANDATORY pattern: Always use TOP N to limit results. Reference tables require LEFT JOIN (nullable FKs). See docs/platforms/inhouse_print_database_schema_v2.md for complete schema.

query.description: SQL query to execute. MUST use TOP N (recommended: TOP 20). MUST use correct column names from database_guide. MUST use [Desc] with brackets for PaperSize/JobType/PaperType/JobStage/GSM. MUST use BindTypeDesc (not [Desc]) for BindType. MUST JOIN Orders for dates. Example: SELECT TOP 20 o.OrderID, o.Invoiced, jt.Cost, ps.[Desc] AS PaperSize FROM Orders o JOIN JobTickets jt ON o.OrderID = jt.OrderID LEFT JOIN PaperSize ps ON jt.PaperSizeID = ps.SizeID

returns.description: Query results as array of row objects with actual column values from FRED database
